# Stock S2b-L trusted registration fixtures

This directory is test-only evidence for schema-4 registration/linking. Production
receives only opaque raw class bytes and page/hash commitments; it does not read
this manifest, Java sources, catalogue, parsed methods, offsets, call targets, or
oracle outcomes.

`catalogue/catalogue.jsonl` is the unchanged 268-row / 94-root M1-through-M3a
oracle catalogue (SHA-256
`77d8000e5533803a7113f51dbf9db9eb1fa0cc2a566fc4e6852fa18581486d55`).
It remains JVM/monolithic-oracle evidence only: S2b-L does not execute these rows,
resume a machine, or issue Java outcomes.

The fourteen classes are rebuilt together from the existing differential sources
with `javac --release 8` and pinned by exact raw SHA-256 in `manifest.json`.
`cap/S2bValidCaps.class.hex` is the unchanged 3,574-byte JVM-valid simultaneous-cap
class generated by `cap/make_class.py`; it has 32 methods, 256 literal records,
32 call records, and a 7,936-byte metadata payload. The committed raw hash is
`0e3e962a3de46d9c019c8e8e3e846b304622fc969144713f9ad6922c33946f33`.
The generator is test fixture tooling and is never used by production.

`cfg/ValidRevisitCFG` is a small JVM-valid loop whose definite-local merge loses a
bit after a back edge. It guards the production bounded de-duplicated worklist
against the old `codeLength+1` total-enqueue shortcut. Its source and raw bytes are
both pinned; source compilation is test-side oracle work only.
